_comment: Paste each tool individually into the Telnyx AI Assistant 'Tools' tab. Every tool POSTs to the ai-tool-router edge function: https://sxdraeptzuamsgjcvfeg.supabase.co/functions/v1/ai-tool-router?tool=<name>. The router switches on the ?tool= query param and returns the JSON the assistant needs.
_auth: None — verify_jwt is OFF on the function. The router does its own per-call validation.

tools.name: lookup_customer
tools.description: Look up a customer by phone number. Returns booking history, contact details, membership status, outstanding balance, payment status, and a payment link if any balance is owed. ALWAYS call this on the first message of a conversation so you have context.

phone.description: Customer's phone in any format. E.164 preferred (e.g. +14436486798).

tools.name: check_service_area
tools.description: Check whether a ZIP code is in Novara's service area. Returns city + state + zone if serviced.

tools.name: get_price_estimate
tools.description: Calculate the price for a cleaning. Uses the live pricing-system (50% NEW promo applied automatically for first-time customers).

home_size_id.description: Sqft tier. Use the bedrooms-to-sqft map in the system prompt §3.A.

add_ons.description: Optional extras. Ignored for moveInOut (fridge+oven included).

membership_plan.description: Default 'none' (one-off). Set to a Glow tier if customer is enrolling.

is_new_customer.description: True if no prior completed bookings on file. From lookup_customer.

returns.human_summary: string (one-line price recap for the AI to paste verbatim)

tools.name: get_available_slots
tools.description: Get available time slots for a given date. Returns up to 5 nearest available start times.

service_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Must be ≥ 3 days from today and not a Sunday.

service_duration_hours.description: Estimated job hours from the home size + service type. Defaults to 2.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Create a pending_payment booking and return a Stripe Payment Link for the deposit. Customer pays via the link → Stripe webhook auto-confirms.

time_slot.description: Slot id from get_available_slots (e.g. '9:00 AM - 10:00 AM').

access_notes.description: Optional: gate code, parking, key location.

returns.payment_link: string (Stripe Payment Link URL — send this to the customer verbatim)

tools.name: handle_keyword
tools.description: Hand a deterministic keyword (R / C / YES / NO / STOP / HELP) off to the existing sms-inbound function so the reschedule / cancel / opt-out flows behave consistently with the SMS confirmations we send.

returns.reply_text: string (paste verbatim back to the customer)
returns.action_taken: string (cancel_prompt | cancel_executed | reschedule_prompt | declined | help | stop)

tools.name: add_to_waitlist
tools.description: Add a customer to the waitlist when their ZIP is outside the service area.

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.description: Flag this conversation for human takeover. Stops AI auto-replies for 4 hours and notifies the on-call admin.

summary.description: 1-2 sentence handoff note for the human.
